dogecoin.text:
a humorous tweet with two variations

Darth Vader: “You came for $DOGE, but now you belong to the dark side… here $SHIBA is hope, $PEPE is logic, $FLOKI is patience, and $WIF only barks.” I wanted to be a Jedi, now my portfolio looks like a meme soup. The Force? It’s just pure

$PEPE pumped 200 percent so I bought dog food. Then $FLOKI crashed and the dog left me. Now I'm trying to make peace with $DOGE but it says “I don’t talk unless Elon tweets.” This ain’t crypto, this is a telenovela. #Memecoin #Crypto #PEPE #DOGE #FLOKI

It’s July 21 and the memecoin squad still believes in going to the moon. $DOGE is sipping coffee, $SHIBA is meditating, $PEPE is filming TikToks, $FLOKI is staring at space, and $WIF says we will bark our way to riches. Either we’re insane or we’re early. #Memecoin #Crypto #DOGE
